data.title: The Damage Resistance Update Is Live!
data.meta_title: The Damage Resistance Update Is Live!
data.content:
The battle for Tortuga escalates with the launch of the Damage Resistance Battle Pass, running from December 9 to January 18. As storms tear across Martian ridges and fortified ports, Carmen Ruiz enters the fray—commanding a heavily armored Decker War Robot, armed and reinforced for frontline dominance. Now she’s ready to lead her Dominion, and you can recruit her yourself.

Damage Resistance Battle Pass

The Damage Resistance Battle Pass delivers a full arsenal of defensive upgrades and Martian-themed rewards. Level up with XP and Battle Tokens to unlock shipments packed with:

  • Hefty Weapons
  • Decker War Robot Modules
  • Supply & Cycle Gear
  • Paints, Cosmetics, Wear & Tear
  • Planet-inspired Stickers & Decals
  • Resources: Credits, Salvage, and Intel
  • And the Hero Pilot: Carmen Ruiz

Choose your path:

  • Free Battle Pass — Progress and unlock select rewards without spending.
  • Battle Pass Gold (200 WarpReals) — Earn enough Tokens to claim every item across all shipments.

Complete all four shipments before January 18 to secure every reward and prepare for the escalating conflict on Tortuga.

Patchwork Steel Twitch Drops (December 9–23)

Watch Drop-enabled War Robots: Frontiers streams on Twitch to claim rewards such as Credits, Salvage, Premium time, Intel, Tusk & Vortex weapons, and Loki and Phantom parts. Just link your account, tune in, and earn as you watch.

Intel Discount Event (December 9–16)

Upgrade your Builds for less! Intel costs are reduced for a limited time—perfect for enhancing featured modules (Orochi, Varangian, Lancelot, Volta), weapons (Zeus, Orkan, Punisher, Cascade), and gear like Recon Mode, Iron Veil, and more.

Solidus Node: Umbra (December 9–23)

Dive back into the industrial shadows of Umbra, available in a dedicated unranked queue. Expect tight corridors, layered cover, and brutal close-quarters firefights.

Gear up, Pilot, the fight is intensifying. The Dominion needs every edge it can get.

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

Steam │ MY.GAMES Launcher

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
